---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    home_runs_per_team_game = sum(HR) / sum(G),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_team_game)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Home Runs per Team Game Over Time",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per team game"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
